basics.name: Luong Tin Phan, Ph.D.
basics.label: Robotics Technology Leader | Motion Planning & Control | Physical AI | Industrial Functional Safety
basics.summary: Robotics engineering leader with a Ph.D. in robotics (quadruped locomotion control, Sungkyunkwan University) and a track record of taking robots from R&D to continuous industrial deployment. Built and owned motion planning, real-time control and multi-robot coordination stacks for AMRs, automated parking and autonomous vehicles, including Vietnam's first robot Fleet Management System running 24-hour, 6-day-a-week operations at major FDI manufacturing sites. Leads engineering teams and system architecture for safe, always-on operation, with hands-on delivery against ISO 13849-1 (safety of machinery control systems), ISO 3691-4 (driverless industrial trucks) and ISO 14644 Class 6 cleanroom environments. Currently heading R&D for Physical AI on humanoid and quadruped platforms and LLM-enabled service robots.

work.name: Next Robotics
work.position: Chief of Revenue & Operations / Head of R&D
highlights: Own presales and client acquisition end to end, from solution design and cost estimation for strategic bids to contract closing; delivered the company's all-time-high sales in 2026.
Oversee hardware outsourcing, procurement and inventory for cost efficiency, and direct project delivery from planning to on-time, high-quality execution.
Opened new markets with two ongoing projects in Japan and Korea, and won the first Physical AI project with a new strategic customer.
Lead the R&D team on new strategic products: Physical AI for humanoids and quadrupeds, and LLM-based interaction for service robots.

work.name: Next Robotics (FPT Software spin-off)
highlights: Product Owner and system architect of the Fleet Management System (FMS) for AMRs: multi-robot coordination and motion planning; the first robot FMS developed in Vietnam.
Achieved 2 mm AMR positioning accuracy, about 5 times more precise than the typical industry level.
Led the engineering team from architecture to on-site commissioning at major FDI manufacturing sites; 50+ robots running continuously in 24-hour, 6-day-a-week operations.

Engineered deployments to industrial safety standards: ISO 13849-1 (safety-related parts of control systems), ISO 3691-4 (driverless industrial trucks/AGVs), and ISO 14644 Class 6 cleanroom environments.

work.name: FPT Software
highlights: Motion Planning owner and architect for automated car parking and AMR products; approximately 10 cm parking accuracy and 3 cm AMR positioning accuracy.
Delivered Vietnam's first complete automated parking system (perpendicular, parallel and angled) and the first multi-AMR warehouse deployments in Vietnam.

work.name: VinAI Research
highlights: Developed motion planning and control for autonomous vehicles using camera and RTK-GNSS localization over DDS middleware; supported public-road testing.
Contributed to Vietnam's first autonomous vehicle operating on normal roads at high speed.

work.name: Rapyuta Robotics
highlights: Developed AMR behaviors and LiDAR SLAM on ROS, including an autonomous forklift with partners.
Tested and benchmarked robot performance; set up and configured safety devices (SICK laser scanners, proximity sensors).

work.name: Nguyen Tat Thanh University; University of Greenwich Vietnam
highlights: Director, automa Lab (NTTU); helped launch the undergraduate Electric Vehicle major.
Lecturer; designed syllabi for Self-Driving Operating Systems and Motion Planning.

courses: Thesis: Control Strategy for a Running Quadruped Robot with an Articulated Spine. Advisor: Prof. Hyouk Ryeol Choi.
Publications: 2 journal articles, 2 IEEE/RSJ IROS papers, 2 URAI papers.

awards.title: Silver Prize, OpenCV Spatial AI Competition
Full scholarship for the combined M.S./Ph.D. program
